Sample models of Khronos' glTF-Sample-Assets (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets), copied unchanged.
Every model here is licensed Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal (public domain), as the "Legal" section of its README says; the line of each follows.
